title: Barenco gate implementation using driven two- and three-qubit spin chains
summary: We propose a protocol for implementing Barenco-type multi-qubit controlled gates using short driven spin chains. Starting from an Ising interaction with a transverse drive on the last spin, we construct an effective two-qubit Hamiltonian whose time evolution implements the Barenco gate $V_2(\varphi,ω,φ)$ and, in particular, a CNOT gate. We then embed this construction into a three-qubit $XXZ$ chain to realize the three-qubit Barenco gate $V_3(\varphi,ω,φ)$, which includes the Toffoli gate as a special case.
